name: ln-fitting-procedure
description: Fitting LN, GLM-with-feedback and two-arm cascade models to retinal stimulus-response recordings, in the CascadeGraph parameterization. Recordings declare their sampling interval, response units and array layout in a data contract that is checked against the file before a fit runs -- a response left in volts, or an array stored transposed, does not error, it quietly fits the wrong thing. MATLAB and Python fitters cross-checked to ~1e-13, with automatic per-fit diagnostics.
